WITH all_accounts_with_town AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    c.town_city
  FROM Accounts a
  JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL AND c.town_city != ''
),
account_transactions AS (
  SELECT 
    aat.account_id,
    aat.town_city,
    COUNT(ft.transaction_id) as transaction_count
  FROM all_accounts_with_town aat
  LEFT JOIN Financial_Transactions ft ON aat.account_id = ft.account_id
  GROUP BY aat.account_id, aat.town_city
),
town_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    town_city,
    SUM(transaction_count) as town_transaction_total
  FROM account_transactions
  GROUP BY town_city
),
global_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(transaction_count) as total_transactions,
    COUNT(account_id) as total_accounts
  FROM account_transactions
)
SELECT 
  at.account_id,
  at.town_city,
  at.transaction_count,
  CASE WHEN tt.town_transaction_total = 0 THEN 0.0 ELSE CAST(at.transaction_count AS FLOAT) / tt.town_transaction_total END as share_of_town,
  CAST(at.transaction_count AS FLOAT) / (gs.total_transactions / CAST(gs.total_accounts AS FLOAT)) as ratio_to_average
FROM account_transactions at
JOIN town_totals tt ON at.town_city = tt.town_city
CROSS JOIN global_stats gs
ORDER BY ratio_to_average DESC
LIMIT 10
